We will use the following identity:

$$
∇\cdot (f\,F)=f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f
$$

First, we compute $∇\cdot F$ and $∇f.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f & =⟨0,2y⟩, \\ ∇\cdot F & =\frac{∂}{∂x}(-{x}^{2})+\frac{∂}{∂y}(\frac{1}{2}{y}^{2})=-2x+y.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}∇\cdot (f\,F) & =f\,∇\cdot F+F\cdot ∇f \\  & ={y}^{2}(-2x+y)+⟨-{x}^{2},\frac{1}{2}{y}^{2}⟩\cdot ⟨0,2y⟩ \\  & =-2x{y}^{2}+{y}^{3}+{y}^{3} \\  & =2{y}^{3}-2x{y}^{2} \\  & =2{y}^{2}(y-x).\end{aligned}
$$
